title: Extremely helpful receptionist
content: Receptionist listened to the reason for my appointment and discussed the appointment options. She offered me a face to face appointment with the GP dealing with dermatology problems, explaining that it would be at least a couple of weeks away.  The service she was able to offer was way beyond my expectations and her manner was exemplary.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
